title: pane.last_output
description: Returns the output of the pane's last command as plain text, as pane.read does: from the shell's OSC 133 C mark to the D mark after it, or to the end while the command runs. Program output can fake the marks. A pane with no marks is refused. Needs hello version 2, and the pane must be the caller's own or one it spawned, or one they spawned (the self and children scopes).

pane.description: The pane's number, which must be the caller's own or one it spawned.
